requirements.required_change: Versioned catalogue with common criteria, provenance and replacement

requirements.mechanism_at_predecessor: Direct route and plan change review

requirements.required_change: Reuse known choice; material drift returns to review

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Uniform scaffold can be mistaken for a design master
requirements.required_change: Bind references, actual concept properties and scope

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Presentation variation may only alter appearance
requirements.required_change: Compare distinct interaction/layout for same need

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: No cross-phase required visual pins
requirements.required_change: Register master, tokens, elements/adaptations

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Proof not always bound to selected concept
requirements.required_change: Bind interaction graph and render evidence

requirements.mechanism_at_predecessor: App Experience, ChatBot Media and Game Assets
requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Export proof may omit master/permissions/versions
requirements.required_change: Pin master, effect recipe and consumer trace

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Naming and module decisions may not carry into implementation
requirements.required_change: Bind architecture, module ownership and validation

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Design may not match deployed data and failure paths
requirements.required_change: Enforce bounded compatible state/data contracts

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Human maintainability evidence not systematically requested
requirements.required_change: Independent run, change and recover case

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Alternatives and exact model use can be declarative
requirements.required_change: Compare and verify applicable route, cost and limits

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Canned checks cannot certify an actual medium
requirements.required_change: Real implemented slice and independent evidence

requirements.mechanism_at_predecessor: Plan change review and context pins
requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Handoff/refresh can materially drift
requirements.required_change: Read and recheck exact approved decision, master and dependency scope

requirements.mechanism_at_predecessor: Shared standards and native entry points
requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Structural parity alone misses bypass
requirements.required_change: Attach operative gate, distribute to exact consumers, audit alternate routes

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Waivers or omitted fields may hide obligations
requirements.required_change: Reject missing hard acceptance and accurately scope evidence

requirements.mechanism_at_predecessor: Portable operating standard, updater and journals
requirements.gap_at_predecessor: New contracts risk rejecting recognised predecessor bytes
requirements.required_change: New release admission plus pinned historical compatibility and scoped adoption

requirements.gap_at_predecessor: Changes need new acceptance/provenance; previous proof remains historic
requirements.required_change: Versioned verified release, fresh adoption and rollback
